features.title: Browse the paginated catalog
features.description: Shows catalog items one page at a time, with page size and page index taken from the request and defaulting to 10 and 0, with Previous and Next links.

features.title: View catalog item details
features.description: Shows one catalog item by id; a missing id returns 400 and an unknown id returns 404.

features.title: Create a catalog item
features.description: A form creates a catalog item with brand and type drop-downs; a valid submission saves the item and returns to the list, and an invalid one shows the form again.

features.title: Edit a catalog item
features.description: An edit form loads an existing item and saves changes through the catalog service; the picture file name is read-only.

features.title: Delete a catalog item
features.description: A confirmation page shows the item before it is removed through the catalog service and the user returns to the list.

features.title: Serve catalog item pictures
features.description: Returns the picture file of a catalog item with a MIME type chosen from its file extension.

features.title: Sign in and sign out with Azure Active Directory
features.description: Signed-in users are shown a greeting and sign-out link, and sign-in is handled through OpenID Connect against Azure AD.

features.title: Filter the catalog by brand and type
features.description: The WinForms catalog screen filters items by brand and type, where 0 means no filter, and shows prices after the current discount.

features.title: Check and record stock per item and date
features.description: The WinForms inventory tab shows the stock of an item on a date and saves a shipment, overwriting the quantity already held for that item and date.

features.title: Brands web API
features.description: A JSON API lists all catalog brands and returns one brand by id.

tables.name: catalog_brand
tables.purpose: Keeps the list of product brands that catalog items refer to.

tables.name: catalog_type
tables.purpose: Keeps the list of product types that catalog items refer to.

tables.name: catalog
tables.purpose: Keeps one row per sellable catalog item with its name, price, picture file name, brand and type, and stock figures.

tables.name: catalog_items_stock
tables.purpose: Keeps the available stock of one catalog item on one date. The stock_id is supplied by the code, not generated by the database.

tables.name: discount_item
tables.purpose: Keeps one discount: a fraction size, read as a percentage after multiplying by 100, and its start and end dates.

flows.title: Browser request to the default MVC route
flows.outcome: The request is served as a static file, or dispatched to an MVC controller action, or to the error page on failure.

flows.title: Create a catalog item
flows.outcome: The item is created and the user sees the catalog index, or the form is shown again with its drop-downs filled.

flows.title: Request a catalog item picture
flows.outcome: The image bytes are returned with a MIME type, or a 400 or 404 response is returned.

flows.title: Add a catalog item
flows.outcome: The form is posted with the entered values; the handler that saves the item is outside this area.

flows.title: Application start-up and container wiring
flows.outcome: MVC, Web API, areas, filters, routes and bundles are registered, and the catalog database initializer is set when mock data is off.

flows.title: Create a catalog item from the admin form
flows.outcome: The new item is saved and the user is sent to the catalog list, or the form is shown again with the errors.

flows.title: Open the home page product list
flows.outcome: The product list and pager show one page of catalog items.

flows.title: Create a catalog item
flows.outcome: A new catalog item is created through the catalog service and the user is redirected to the site root.

flows.title: Edit a catalog item
flows.outcome: The catalog item is updated through the catalog service and the user is redirected to the site root.

flows.title: View item details
flows.outcome: The item is shown as read-only labels, with links to edit it or go back to the list.

flows.title: Delete a catalog item
flows.outcome: The item is removed through the catalog service and the user is redirected to the site root.

flows.title: Application start-up of the MVC site
flows.outcome: The container, routes, bundles, database initializer, catalog images and telemetry are configured and the site can serve requests.

flows.title: Create a catalogue item with a picture
flows.outcome: The item is saved and the user is returned to the catalogue list, or the form is shown again with its errors.

flows.title: Add a stock shipment for a catalog item
flows.outcome: The stock row for the item and date holds the entered quantity, the user sees a confirmation message and the inputs are cleared.

flows.title: Check available stock for an item on a date
flows.outcome: A row with the date, the item id and the stock number is added to the stock result list.

screens.name: Catalog list
screens.purpose: Lists catalog items in a paged table, with links to create, view, edit and delete an item.

screens.name: Create catalog item
screens.purpose: Collects the fields of a new catalog item and saves it, with a cancel link back to the list.

screens.name: Edit catalog item
screens.purpose: Lets a user change an existing catalog item, with the picture file name read-only.

screens.name: Delete catalog item confirmation
screens.purpose: Shows an item and asks the user to confirm its deletion before it is removed.

screens.name: Catalog item details
screens.purpose: Shows one catalog item in read-only form, with links to edit it and to go back to the list.

screens.name: Error page
screens.purpose: Tells the user that a request failed.

screens.name: Contact
screens.purpose: Shows the postal address, phone number and support e-mail links.

screens.name: About
screens.purpose: Shows the about text for the application.

phases.name: Catalog core
phases.goal: The catalog list, details, create, edit and delete run on the new system while the legacy system keeps running.

phases.name: Pictures and seeding
phases.goal: Pictures and the seed data move to the new system.

phases.name: Stock and discounts
phases.goal: Stock records and discounts move to the new system.

phases.name: Retire WebForms
phases.goal: The WebForms front end is replaced last and the legacy system is switched off.

tasks.title: Catalog list with paging
acceptanceCriteria: Given no page size and no page index, when the list is requested, then it shows page 0 with 10 items.
Given page size 10 and page index 1, when the list is requested, then it shows the second page of items ordered by Id.

tasks.title: Catalog item validation rules
acceptanceCriteria: Given a price of 1000001, when the item is saved, then it is refused as above the limit.
Given an available stock of 10000001, when the item is saved, then it is refused.

tasks.title: Create, edit and delete catalog items for signed-in users
acceptanceCriteria: Given an anonymous visitor, when the create page is posted, then the visitor is sent to sign in.
Given a signed-in user and a valid item, when it is saved, then the user is returned to the list.
